skills.name: Rapid Strike
skills.description:
A swift, repeatable attack, dealing 6 (0 + 75% Melee Attack) Physical Damage to a single target.
Marks the target with each hit, reducing their Skill Damage -1% and Move Speed -2% per stack. Inflicts Shaken each time it reaches 5 stacks, further reducing their Skill Damage, Move Speed, and Attack Speed.
Backstabbing increases Melee Critical Rate +50%.
Hold down for continuous use.

skills.name: Wallop
skills.description:
Launches four attacks in quick succession dealing 1710 (1671 + 380% Melee Attack) Physical Damage.
The first attack Staggers the target, briefly stopping movement and canceling all Cast Time and Channeled skills.
Every successful attack decreases Physical Defense -120.
Grants Bloodthirst for each of the first three attacks, then the fourth deals melee damage equal to 192 times your stacked Bloodthirst.
